This app is a research tool for individuals participating in a research study affiliated with Princeton University. It captures and transmits data about your smartphone activity.

"This app requests that you grant \"Accessibility API permission\". This permission generally enables apps to capture information about the content you see on-screen. This app in particular uses it to capture three specific pieces of information, improving its functionality as a research tool and thus your experience as a research participant. (1) URLs you visit, (2) buttons you tap on, and (3) text you've seen on-screen. In line with the research participation plan you've made with Princeton University, and the research consent form they provide you with, your data is used strictly for scientific analysis. The data is not shared with anyone outside of the designated research team."
This app runs quietly in the background and collects data about how you use your smartphone. It was developed at Princeton University and is used for academic research.
You can pause, restrict, stop, and delete data you upload to us. We stay straightforward. Block SRK from recording apps that you don\'t want recorded. Contact us anytime.
